assessment.what_changed_en: Changes Mannerheim's presidential term end date in the infobox from 4 March 1946 to 11 March 1946 (and in follow-up edits changes the 1919 regency end date from 25 July to 26 July).
assessment.uncertainty_note: Mannerheim submitted his resignation on 4 March 1946 and J. K. Paasikivi took office on 11 March 1946; reference works differ on which date marks the end of the term.
assessment.historical_note_en: Following Mannerheim's resignation letter of 4 March 1946, Prime Minister Paasikivi discharged presidential duties until Parliament elected Paasikivi president on 9 March and he took office on 11 March 1946.

assessment.uncertainty_note: President Kallio appointed Mannerheim commander of Finland's armed forces in October 1939 before ceding wartime supreme command on 30 November 1939; the edits bundled office-title restructuring with unexplained date shifts.
assessment.historical_note_en: Finnish constitutional practice distinguished peacetime Defence Forces command from the President's supreme command (*ylipäällikkyys*), which Kallio transferred to Mannerheim when the Winter War began.
